source_channel_selection_policy.measurement: 10*log10(mean(((L+R)/2)^2)/mean((L^2+R^2)/2)) over full original decoded sample before offset/resampling
source_channel_selection_policy.action_below_threshold: Copy original channel with larger full-sample RMS to both outputs; do not average, flip, normalize or rewrite original cache file
source_channel_selection_policy.audit: Per used source: threshold, original energy loss, left/right RMS and selected channel. Information, not a musical adaptation error.
source_channel_selection_policy.reason: Verified inter-microphone cancellation in VSCO upright piano and some flute sources; authorized evidence-based exception to initial freeze

local_mapping_overrides.reason: Recorded RR2 is within 0.35 dB of RR1 on measured native levels; explicit upstream +12 dB region gain causes a reproduced 12.22 dB peak jump. Local gain 0 dB restores matched RR response. No source WAV or upstream SFZ bytes are changed.
